verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a remote-desktop app, since Sill keeps settings and paired-device data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no account, no server, open-source code and plain log files, but nothing documents an export of user data in open formats. Those facts reduce lock-in but are adjacent to an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
